_comment: MEASURED (hull.mjs --write-frame --from hull, 2026-09-29): the VISUAL HULL of the registered turnaround (subjects/apc_8x8/turnaround: side / front / rear / top foregrounds, 0.03 m voxels refined x5, 1743188 surface / shell points) projected through subjects/apc_8x8/camera.json; its bbox fitted to the concept foreground bbox (s = mean of the x / y px-per-m, centres matched). Only _frame is read (scripts/registered.mjs registration).

_frame.note: quadPx = the registered.mjs anchorFace corners (+X flank of the class default body) placed with the fitted s / ox / oy, so registration() recovers them exactly (rms 0); sPxPerM.xOverY != 1 = the concept's aspect differs from the turnaround's (drift); the module's frameScale / frameX / frameY knobs refine the fit
